```{r}

# FDR Program - Benjamini-Hochberg Procedure
fdr_program <- function(p_values, q_value, independent = TRUE) {
  
  #storing original indices
  original_order <- seq_along(p_values)
  
  #creating data frame with p-values and original positions
  p_data <- data.frame(original_index = original_order , p_value = p_values)
  
  #sorting p-values in ascending order
  p_sorted <- p_data[order(p_data$p_value), ]
  
  #getting number of tests
  m <- length(p_values)
  
  #calculating ordering (rank) for each p-value
  ordering <- 1:m
  
  #calculating critical value line
  if (independent) 
  {
    critical_line <- (ordering / m) * q_value
    assumption <- "Independent"
  } 
  else 
  {
    #calculating harmonic sum for dependent tests
    c_m <- sum(1 / (1:m))
    critical_line <- (ordering / m) * (q_value / c_m)
    assumption <- "Dependent, or unknown dependence"
  }
  
  #finding discoveries: p(i) <= critical_line(i)
  discoveries_indicator <- p_sorted$p_value <= critical_line
  
  #finding the largest index where p-value is below the line
  if (any(discoveries_indicator))
  {
    max_discovery_index <- max(which(discoveries_indicator))
    discovery_indices <- p_sorted$original_index[1:max_discovery_index]
  }
  else
  {
    discovery_indices <- integer(0)
    max_discovery_index <- 0
  }
  
  # creating the plot
  plot(ordering, p_sorted$p_value , type = "l" , lwd = 2 , xlab = "ordering" , ylab = "pvalue" , main = "FDR program" , ylim = c(0 , max(c(p_sorted$p_value , critical_line))))
  
  # adding the critical value line
  lines(ordering, critical_line, col = "red", lwd = 1)
  
  # outputting results
  cat("FDR PROGRAM RESULTS")
  cat("Assumption:" , assumption)
  cat("Number of tests:" , m)
  cat("Desired FDR, q-value:" , q_value)
  
  if (length(discovery_indices) > 0)
  {
    cat("Number of discoveries:" , length(discovery_indices))
    cat("Tests considered 'interesting' (discoveries):")
    cat("Original indices:" , discovery_indices)
    cat("Corresponding p-values:")
    print(p_values[discovery_indices])
  } 
  else
  {
    cat("No discoveries found at FDR level" , q_value)
  }
  
  # returning results
  invisible(list(
    discoveries = discovery_indices,
    assumption = assumption,
    n_discoveries = length(discovery_indices),
    sorted_pvalues = p_sorted,
    critical_line = critical_line
  ))
}

#function testing
set.seed(123)
psmall.renal <- c(runif(20, 0, 0.01) , runif(80, 0.1, 1))
plarge.renal <- c(runif(50, 0, 0.05) , runif(1950, 0.1, 1))

#test 1: psmall.renal with independence
cat("TEST 1: psmall.renal (Independent)")
result1 <- fdr_program(psmall.renal, q_value = 0.1, independent = TRUE)

# test 2: plarge.renal with independence
cat("TEST 2: plarge.renal (Independent)")
result2 <- fdr_program(plarge.renal, q_value = 0.1, independent = TRUE)

# test 3: psmall.renal without independence
cat("TEST 3: psmall.renal (Dependent)")
result3 <- fdr_program(psmall.renal, q_value = 0.1, independent = FALSE)

# test 4: plarge.renal without independence
cat("TEST 4: plarge.renal (Dependent)")
result4 <- fdr_program(plarge.renal, q_value = 0.1, independent = FALSE)
```
